name: envden
description: Encrypted whole-file env sync over your private network

commands.name: setup
commands.description: Create a vault and configure this device

options.name: yes
options.description: Take defaults; secrets and checkout approval still require your terminal

options.name: kitOut
options.description: Write the recovery kit as JSON to a private file instead of a PDF

options.name: hostServer
options.description: Run the envden server on this machine; no setup token needed

options.name: setupToken
options.description: Setup token, visible to other processes; use the prompt in a terminal

options.name: verbose
options.description: List each repo and env file the scan skipped

commands.name: join
commands.description: Join using a pairing code or recovery kit in your own terminal

options.name: recovery
options.description: Paste a recovery secret key and vault ID

options.name: resume
options.description: Finish a join that was approved while this command wasn't running

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show what changed here, what's newer on the server and what needs attention

commands.name: push
commands.description: Send your changes to the server

commands.name: pull
commands.description: Fetch and merge changes from your other devices

commands.name: diff
commands.description: Show changed key names without values

commands.name: resolve
commands.description: Keep yours, take the server's, or finish an edited conflict

commands.name: history
commands.description: List the versions the server keeps, or restore one as a local edit

options.name: restore
options.description: Write that version into the checkout without pushing

commands.name: track
commands.description: Scan, approve and link checkout env files

options.name: copy
options.description: Place real copies instead of links

options.name: verbose
options.description: List each repo and env file the scan skipped

arguments.name: path
arguments.description: Checkout or scan root (default: current directory)

commands.name: untrack
commands.description: Stop tracking a checkout and restore regular env files

commands.name: local-only
commands.description: Keep a managed file local to this checkout

arguments.name: file
arguments.description: Managed env file in this checkout

commands.name: rm
commands.description: Remove an env file everywhere on the next push

options.name: yes
options.description: Confirm deletion, including local edits and conflicts

commands.name: alias
commands.description: Share another repo's env files, for example from a fork

arguments.name: target
arguments.description: Repo ID whose env files it uses

commands.name: device
commands.description: Add, list, rename and remove devices

commands.name: add
commands.description: Show a pairing code for a new device

commands.name: ls
commands.description: List devices and the version each last used

commands.name: rename
commands.description: Rename this device

arguments.name: name
arguments.description: New name, unique in the vault

commands.name: rm
commands.description: Remove a device and re-key the vault so it can't read new changes

options.name: kitOut
options.description: Write the new recovery kit as JSON to a private file instead of a PDF

options.name: newKit
options.description: Also replace the recovery kit as part of the removal

commands.name: vault
commands.description: Re-key the vault, replace the recovery kit, or change or reset the password

commands.name: rotate
commands.description: Re-key the vault so removed devices can't read new changes

commands.name: kit
commands.description: Manage the recovery kit

commands.name: replace
commands.description: Replace a lost kit; needs the master password

options.name: kitOut
options.description: Write the new recovery kit as JSON to a private file instead of a PDF

commands.name: password
commands.description: Change or reset the master password

commands.name: change
commands.description: Change the password; needs the old one and the kit

commands.name: reset
commands.description: Reset a forgotten password with the kit

commands.name: server
commands.description: Move, switch or repair the server

commands.name: move
commands.description: Move the vault to a new server

options.name: setupToken
options.description: Setup token, visible to other processes; use the prompt in a terminal

commands.name: switch
commands.description: Follow a signed move when the old server is unreachable

commands.name: repair
commands.description: After a server restore, re-upload this device's data, or finish the restore with --finish

options.name: repairToken
options.description: Repair token; prefer stdin for upload, use a terminal for --finish

options.name: finish
options.description: Check every device's upload and finish the restore

options.name: without
options.description: Drop unavailable devices; they rejoin as new devices

options.name: acceptLost
options.description: Accept the newest verified older version of a missing file

commands.name: unlock
commands.description: Log in with your master password to restart the unlock period

commands.name: config
commands.description: Read or change settings

arguments.name: key
arguments.description: telemetry, update-check, agent-merge, auto-approve-worktrees, unlock-period, placement or env-files

arguments.name: values
arguments.description: New value; placement takes a checkout path and link or copy

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Check key files, symlinks, updates, Tailscale, HTTPS and shell notices

commands.name: update
commands.description: Update envden through the method it was installed with

options.name: check
options.description: Check for a release without installing

commands.name: ui
commands.description: Open a local dashboard for this device

options.name: open
options.description: Print the link without opening a browser

commands.name: agent
commands.description: Install the envden agent skill

commands.name: install
commands.description: Install or refresh the agent skill

commands.name: shell
commands.description: Manage the shell notice

commands.name: install
commands.description: Add the out-of-sync notice to your shell config

commands.name: uninstall
commands.description: Remove the out-of-sync notice from your shell config

commands.name: serve
commands.description: Run the server; ENVDEN_SETUP_TOKEN replaces the setup token

options.name: restored
options.description: Start a restored backup in repair-only mode

commands.name: version
commands.description: Print the version
